description: Five standard task categories (four software engineering stages + Bug tracking). server.js automatically pre-provisions corresponding shared lists upon startup if missing.

categories.name: Architecture & Design
categories.description: System architecture design, module boundaries, technology selection, and interface contracts.

categories.name: Core Features
categories.description: Business feature implementations, API endpoints, and module coding tasks (can derive from architecture).

categories.name: Testing & QA
categories.description: Unit tests, integration tests, regression tests, and verification tasks.

categories.name: Benchmarks & Acceptance
categories.description: Reusable test benchmarks, acceptance criteria, and golden test scenarios with standard inputs/outputs.

categories.name: Bug Tracking
categories.description: Defects, runtime exceptions, regressions, and optimization opportunities discovered during development.

traceability.label: Feature not verified by test
traceability.hint: Tasks in owner list not yet referenced by referrer list via this relation (test coverage gap)

traceability.label: Architecture task without derived feature
traceability.hint: No feature tasks declared as deriving from this architecture task (implementation gap)

traceability.label: Orphan item without links
traceability.hint: Tasks that neither reference nor are referenced by other tasks

archive.description: A1 auto-archive policy. Startup sweep moves lists with closed top-level items >= minClosed to data/archive/<listId>.json; protected lists are never auto-archived.
